description: This file defines the DragManager class responsible for handling drag-and-drop operations within Chromium-based pages in Playwright. It manages drag state, intercepts drag events, and communicates with the browser via protocol commands.

classes.name: DragManager
classes.description: Manages drag-and-drop interactions, including starting, canceling, and dropping drags, as well as intercepting drag events caused by move actions.

methods.name: cancelDrag
methods.description: Cancels the current drag operation if one is active.

methods.name: interceptDragCausedByMove
methods.description: Handles drag interception during move events, setting up listeners and managing drag state.

methods.name: isDragging
methods.description: Returns whether a drag operation is currently active.

methods.name: drop
methods.description: Completes the drag operation by dispatching a drop event at specified coordinates.
